userSpecifiedSources: MLIT Traffic Volume API (交通量API, reference values), data provided by the Japan Road Traffic Information Center (JARTIC, https://www.jartic-open-traffic.org/); place names from the GSI reverse geocoder (国土地理院). Collected three times a day and built by https://github.com/yasumorishima/japan-road-traffic, which uploads a day only when every check passes.

counters.csv.description: One row per counter (ID and sensor) seen in the API or the archive: location, prefecture, municipality and town (GSI reverse geocoder), and the last day it reported.

columns.counter_id: Counter ID (常時観測点コード)
columns.sensor: loop = permanent counter, cctv = AI count on CCTV images; (counter_id, sensor) is the key
columns.longitude: Longitude, WGS84, as given by the source
columns.latitude: Latitude, WGS84, as given by the source
columns.prefecture: Prefecture at the location (Japanese), from the GSI reverse geocoder
columns.municipality_code: Five-digit local government code (全国地方公共団体コード without the check digit) with its leading zero (01337); read it as text, e.g. pandas dtype={'municipality_code': str}
columns.municipality: City, ward, town or village at the location (Japanese)
columns.town: Town or district name at the location (Japanese), from the GSI reverse geocoder; can be empty
columns.in_5min_box: True when the counter is inside the Kanto box that has five-minute data (longitude 138.4-140.95, latitude 34.85-37.2)
columns.last_seen: Latest day (JST) this counter reported in the API or in the archive

five_minute_kanto_2026-09.parquet.description: Five-minute vehicle counts for 2026-09 (JST) inside the Kanto box (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki, Tochigi, Gunma and edges): permanent and CCTV counters. One row per five minutes, counter and sensor.

columns.time_jst: Start of the interval (the source's time code), Japan Standard Time (UTC+9), no time zone attached. Five-minute code 09:05 is 09:05-09:09 in the API specification
columns.counter_id: Counter ID (常時観測点コード). The same ID can exist as a permanent counter and as a CCTV counter: the key is (counter_id, sensor); join counters.csv on both
columns.sensor: loop = permanent counter (loop or ultrasonic detector), cctv = AI count on CCTV images
columns.road_type: 1 = expressway (高速自動車国道) with an MLIT counter, 3 = national highway (一般国道)
columns.regional_bureau: Regional bureau number (地方整備局等番号): 81 Hokkaido, 82 Tohoku, 83 Kanto, 84 Hokuriku, 85 Chubu, 86 Kinki, 87 Chugoku, 88 Shikoku, 89 Kyushu, 90 Okinawa
columns.sub_region: Sub-region code (開発建設部／都道府県コード) as given by the source; empty outside Hokkaido and Chubu
columns.up_total: All vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り). CCTV counters only (the source gives it directly); empty for permanent counters, where it is up_small + up_large + up_unclassified
columns.up_small: Small vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.up_large: Large vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.up_unclassified: Vehicles whose size could not be told, the 'up' direction (上り)
columns.down_total: All vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り). CCTV counters only (the source gives it directly); empty for permanent counters, where it is down_small + down_large + down_unclassified
columns.down_small: Small vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.down_large: Large vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.down_unclassified: Vehicles whose size could not be told, the 'down' direction (下り)
columns.up_power_failure: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a power failure, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_loop_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a loop detector fault, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_ultrasonic_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags an ultrasonic detector fault, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_missing: Permanent counters: True when the source flags the value as missing (欠測), the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_power_failure: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a power failure, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_loop_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a loop detector fault, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_ultrasonic_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags an ultrasonic detector fault, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_missing: Permanent counters: True when the source flags the value as missing (欠測), the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_missing_processing: Hourly CCTV only: the source's 5分欠測処理フラグ, the 'up' direction (上り). The API specification defines 1 = five-minute processing and 2 = one hour; 0 also occurs and is not defined there. Kept as the integer code
columns.down_missing_processing: Hourly CCTV only: the source's 5分欠測処理フラグ, the 'down' direction (下り). The API specification defines 1 = five-minute processing and 2 = one hour; 0 also occurs and is not defined there. Kept as the integer code
columns.cam_preset_position: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = camera is off its preset position (カメラプリセット位置); the source blanks the counts then, False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_weather_degraded: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = image degraded by weather (気象影響による映像不良), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_low_light: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = not enough light (照度不足), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_incident: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = incident such as a traffic accident (突発事象（交通事故等）), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_server_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = server not running (サーバの稼働), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_feed_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = video feed not received (カメラの映像受信), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_decode_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = video decoding failed (映像のデコード処理), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_import_failure: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = decoded video could not be passed to the analyser (取込加工処理の失敗), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_analyzer_freeze: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = the image analyser froze (映像解析機能のフリーズ), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_other_error: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = other error (その他エラー), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
